name: popover
title: Popover
description: A hover card that opens above a mention chip as the cursor arrives, then closes when it leaves.
useWhen: Showing a hover card with richer content than a single-line tooltip.
Demonstrating a popover opening and closing on the timeline.
The overlay should enter from a specific side.
avoidWhen: You only need a single-line label: use tooltip.
You need a persistent side panel with actions: use sheet.
The overlay is a blocking modal: use alert-dialog.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Handle
variables.description: Text of the chip the cursor hovers.

variables.label: Side
variables.description: Which side of the chip the card opens on.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the scripted interaction. 2 plays it twice as fast and holds the end.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the control sits over your own scene.
